mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.5%) signals a weak labor market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages indicates a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy enters a slowdown phase.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both below 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 during a late-cycle expansion regime signals weakening supply chain capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as growth concerns intensify.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0 and regime is late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL > 231.75) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain high interest rates that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 231.75.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) during a post-recession recovery regime signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and regime is post-recession recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 1.5% (GDPC1 > 13616.2) indicates strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 13616.2.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 97.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 97.0.
